$comment: Trackman's answers (synthetic) -> olmd/1 batches. input.fetched: {sessions: [{activity, node}], scorecards, round_shots: [{id, holes}], shots_none}. Compare as JSON values; numbers exactly, except in rounds[].shots[] where a number may differ by compare.round_shot_tolerance (rounding to centimetres differs between languages at exact halves).

cases.name: simulator_session
cases.why: A bay session: ball and club data, a stroke without flight left out.

cases.name: range_session
cases.why: A range session names its spin ballSpin and may send only the total side; where both spins come, spinRate wins.

cases.name: session_kinds
cases.why: Kinds map to olmd's; unknown ones are 'other'; played rounds and sessions without an id are no sessions; a number as id is written out.

cases.name: junk_strokes
cases.why: Every field may be missing or of the wrong type: mapped or dropped, never fatal. Numbers written as text are dropped; times are RFC 3339 only.

cases.name: club_names
cases.why: Trackman's club names and their canonical codes.

cases.name: broken_scorecard
cases.why: Text where numbers belong, a course that is no object, holes that are no holes.

cases.name: round_shots_chain
cases.why: Without positions each shot starts where the one before stopped; after a penalty or a drop at Trackman's target distance; a holed shot ends at 0.

cases.name: round_shots_points
cases.why: With positions the distances to the flag and where each shot came to rest against the line to it are worked out from x and z; putts the simulator adds, gimmes and pick-ups are no penalties.

cases.name: round_shots_junk
cases.why: Holes and shots that are none are left out; the first shot of a number wins.

cases.name: rounds_merged
cases.why: Shots join their scorecard; shots for a round sent earlier come with its id only; a round without shots at Trackman carries shots: [].

cases.name: round_shots_measured
cases.why: Asked with ball and club data: each shot carries them as a bay stroke does (carry and total stay the shot's own fields), and the round says it was asked (shots_measured). Shots asked without them carry none, and their round says nothing.

cases.name: round_shots_refused
cases.why: What Trackman refused of the question goes with the round in its extra: the fields it named (names only; anything else is dropped) and its words, at most 300 characters. A round asked without the values at all carries Trackman's words alone.

round_shots.said: The field `spinRate` does not exist on the type `ShotMeasurement`. 

extra.round_shots_refused: The field `spinRate` does not exist on the type `ShotMeasurement`. xxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxx

cases.name: nothing_new
cases.why: A sync that found nothing new is an empty batch, not an error.
